text.EN: Damn {killer}. {subject} stood with {faction}; we will answer for this.
text.TL: Putang ina, {killer}. Kasama ni {subject} ang {faction}; gaganti kami.

text.EN: One of ours is down, {subject}. {killer} made enemies of all of us.
text.TL: Nawalan kami ng kasama, {subject}. Ginawang kaaway ni {killer} ang lahat sa amin.

text.EN: We saw {killer} take {subject}. This is not finished.
text.TL: Nakita naming pinatay ni {killer} si {subject}. Hindi pa tapos ito.

text.EN: {killer} killed a member of {faction}. We will remember.
text.TL: Pinatay ni {killer} ang kasapi ng {faction}. Tatandaan namin ito.

text.EN: Run while you can, {killer}. We will not forget what happened to {subject}.
text.TL: Tumakbo ka habang may oras pa, {killer}. Hindi namin kalilimutan ang nangyari kay {subject}.

text.EN: Hell, {subject}. {killer} will pay for making us weaker.
text.TL: Lintik, {subject}. Magbabayad si {killer} dahil pinahina niya kami.

text.EN: {faction} lost one today. {killer} started something they cannot finish.
text.TL: May nawala sa {faction} ngayon. Sinimulan ito ni {killer} at hindi niya matatapos.

text.EN: We do not forget our own, {subject}. {killer} will answer for this.
text.TL: Hindi namin kinakalimutan ang mga kasama namin, {subject}. Mananagot si {killer}.
